Little River Band of Ottawa Indians

The Little River Band of Ottawa Indians is an individually named community and government route, distinct from other Ottawa/Odawa governments. Its own public introduction connects it with Grand River Ottawa people and several Michigan river systems. A federal conservation account provides a focused example of the Band’s continuing work with lake sturgeon. Together these give a place to begin, while a fuller community-authored history and broader reading collection remain important gaps.

A named Band within wider Odawa contexts

Start with the Band’s own identification statement. Shared Grand River Ottawa histories do not make all present governments interchangeable, and river names alone cannot establish membership, jurisdiction or individual descent.

Read the sources [2] Little River Band of Ottawa Indians

02

Reading contemporary conservation

Zachary Locklear’s Fish and Wildlife Service account names Little River among partners in lake-sturgeon rearing and supplementation in Michigan. It is a useful project perspective, not an independent audit of outcomes or a substitute for the Band’s own longer history.

Read the sources [1] U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; Zachary Locklear

Working with Tribal Partners to Achieve Shared Conservation Goals ↗

An agency account of named Tribal partnerships, including Little River and Gun Lake sturgeon work. It supplies a conservation perspective rather than an entire community history.

Inspection: Content reviewed for the stated scope

Scope: Complete visible article body, lines170–190, read; synthesis uses the named Michigan partnerships at188–189. Linked projects, monitoring datasets and reported outcomes were not independently audited. No current population, legal-rights or programme-success determination.

Little River Band — public community identification ↗

The official public introduction connects the named Band with Grand River Ottawa and the Manistee, Pere Marquette and Grand River systems. Supporting orientation only.

Inspection: Supporting or limited review; see scope

Scope: Only the substantive public community-identification paragraph at117 read for this route; navigation, announcements and member-account content are not source reviews. Linked language site returned520/timeout and was not counted.
